answer: Joining shards run a paired-witness escrow: a claimant may only bridge into a shard after two independent witnesses co-sign its zephyr-denominated deposit, and the credential activates at the next horizon tick once both signatures clear. If either witness later proves the deposit fabricated, the co-signer that vouched for it forfeits 300 POA and the claim is voided, so every fake identity forces the attacker to post one fresh zephyr deposit and expose a vouching peer to a fixed 300 POA penalty, while honest claimants reclaim their escrow untouched.
